About Me

Marzia Zahan Momo

The mind behind the ideas

I am a copywriter and creative communicator with three years of professional agency experience in a remote, part-time role, following a six-month internship. My work spans Bangla and English copywriting, concept development, social media communication, scriptwriting and visual storytelling. With a background in Mass Communication and Journalism from the University of Dhaka, I combine cultural observation, research and visual thinking to develop ideas that connect words with visuals

Campaign

Campaign Development & Execution

CAMPAIGN TITLE

আজ মায়ের ছুটি ক্যাম্পেইন

BRAND: Kazi & Kazi Tea
FORMAT: Social Media Engagement Campaign · Static & Motion Graphics
CAMPAIGN OVERVIEW

A Mother's Day campaign celebrating mothers' everyday dedication by offering a sponsored trip to Cox's Bazar. Participants were invited to share their ideas for giving their mothers a well-deserved break, with selected entries winning the trip sponsorship.

MY ROLE

Proposed campaign names and developed content concepts, scripts, motion graphic ideas and copy based on the client brief. Also simplified participation guidelines into engaging, audience-friendly captions.

CAMPAIGN TITLE

বাবার স্মৃতি, বাবার আদর ক্যাম্পেইন

BRAND: ACI Rice
FORMAT: Social Media Engagement Campaign
CAMPAIGN OVERVIEW

An emotion-led Father's Day campaign inviting audiences to share their favourite memories with their fathers in the comments. Three selected participants would receive gift hampers from the brand, encouraging personal storytelling and meaningful audience engagement.

MY ROLE

Contributed to the campaign concept and naming, developing relatable visual ideas and emotionally engaging copy. Also crafted the primary campaign content and simplified contest guidelines into clear, audience-friendly captions.

CAMPAIGN TITLE

চুমুকে চুমুকে আইফোন জিতুন ক্যাম্পেইন

BRAND: Kazi & Kazi Tea
FORMAT: Promotional Campaign · Static & Motion Graphics
CAMPAIGN DURATION: Three Months per Season · Two Seasons
CAMPAIGN OVERVIEW

A purchase-linked promotional campaign conducted across two seasons. Consumers purchasing eligible Kazi & Kazi Tea products with campaign stickers could register for a chance to win a brand-new iPhone through a lottery, with one winner selected each month over three months.

MY ROLE

Proposed campaign names and contributed to content planning across both seasons. Developed creative concepts, scripts, motion graphic ideas and copy, while translating client-provided participation rules into accessible captions and supporting audience communication.

Scripts

OVC Scriptwriting

PROJECT TITLE

মশা তাড়ায়, ধোঁয়া ছাড়াই

BRAND: Goodknight
PRODUCT: Goodknight Liquid Vaporizer
FORMAT: Online Video Commercial (OVC)
DURATION: 30 Seconds
AGENCY: iHover Communication
MY ROLE: Scriptwriting
THE CREATIVE IDEA & MY CONTRIBUTION

Built around the contrast between smoke-producing mosquito coils and a smokeless alternative, the concept presents Goodknight as a solution to parents' concerns about their children's safety. Following collaborative concept development, I wrote the dialogue-driven script, translating the product's smoke-free USP into a relatable family narrative.

Occasion-Based Social Creatives

PROJECT TITLE

Tea in Every Tongue

BRAND: Kazi & Kazi Tea
FORMAT: Static Social Media Creative
FOCUS: International Mother Language Day
MY ROLE: Concept Development · Copywriting · Visual Ideation
THE CREATIVE IDEA

Drawing on the familiar culture of Bangladeshi tea stalls, the concept celebrates linguistic diversity through three regional dialects. Everyday conversations over tea become a way to highlight the warmth, familiarity and cultural identity carried by one's mother tongue.

PROJECT TITLE

Beyond the Display of Wealth

BRAND: Kazi & Kazi Tea
FORMAT: Static Social Media Creative
FOCUS: Eid-ul-Adha
MY ROLE: Concept Development · Copywriting · Visual Ideation
THE CREATIVE IDEA

A thought-provoking Eid message that challenges the display of wealth and social status surrounding sacrificial animals, bringing attention back to the values of sacrifice, humility and equality. The concept uses a familiar social practice to communicate a message of reflection and togetherness.

PROJECT TITLE

Rights Beyond Symbolic Celebration

BRAND: Kazi & Kazi Tea
FORMAT: Static Social Media Creative
FOCUS: International Women's Day
MY ROLE: Concept Development · Copywriting · Visual Ideation
THE CREATIVE IDEA

A rights-focused message that moves beyond symbolic celebration to address equality, justice and dignity. A series of interconnected statements, reinforced through typographic emphasis, highlights women's demands for rights, fair treatment and meaningful social change.

PROJECT TITLE

A Cup Full of Bengali Celebrations

BRAND: Kazi & Kazi Tea
FORMAT: Static Social Media Creative
FOCUS: Bengali New Year
MY ROLE: Copywriting · Visual Ideation
THE CREATIVE IDEA

A celebration of Bengali New Year through the familiar ritual of tea. The visual brings together elements of Bengali festivities, traditions and everyday life within the form of a steaming tea cup, connecting the brand with the cultural spirit of Pohela Boishakh.
